cells.A2: Updated 24 Oct 2026. Savers put away ₹100 a day by UPI into mutual funds in their own name (80% equity, 20% debt); we earn fund fees and, as a loan marketplace, referral fees from lenders. 9 in 10 savers come online, pan-India; 1 in 10 through doorstep agents in NCR. The app never holds anyone's money.

cells.A13: The main case is the median of the LTV/CAC Monte Carlo (v4 Monte Carlo): the cost to win is measured and held; the ten unmeasured inputs of a saver's value are each drawn anywhere between today's market and our target. Median 1.75x; 23% of draws reach 3x and 84% pay back within 5 years; the company is profitable by month 60 in 46% of draws.
cells.A14: At our targets (every loan target at once: 35% apply a year, ₹3 lakh personal and business loans, home ₹30 lakh, property ₹25 lakh) the saver returns 7.7x and the company is profitable from month 33 on $1.8M. In the main case every unmeasured input sits 48% of the way there; the seed measures them.
